servinfo.title: Fuel Filter Replacement (K14C Model)

attention1.ptxt: Replacing the fuel filter without adequate ventilation may lead to a fire. Replace the fuel filter only in a well-ventilated area away from any open flames (e.g. a gas water heater).

servinfo.ptxt: Fuel filter is installed in fuel pump assembly inside fuel tank.
Replace fuel pump assembly with new one periodically.
